prompt: Navy plants a garden behind the school
title: Our Garden Fun
irony: Navy gives every seed away until his hands are empty, yet the seeds he gave away grow into the shared garden that feeds him too.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Morning sun warms the big-house yard where Navy holds up a bright seed packet.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Navy wants a garden behind the school and hands out seeds to every friend passing by.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Black bets the dry schoolyard dirt grows nothing, so Navy must prove him wrong.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The friends chant the garden hook and pat the dry schoolyard soil together.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Navy digs with Green's facts but waters too fast and the seeds wash into a heap.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Navy gives his last seeds to Black and stands with an empty packet.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The friends sing the hook again while staring at the empty muddy rows.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Gray kneels in the quiet garden and owns planning too much instead of planting.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Gray decides to risk planting together, and Navy offers his empty hands to help.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: The cast sings the hook with Gray's turned line about sharing the garden.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: The friends sing the hook in the blooming garden behind the school cottages.
